outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially open, projecting outward in image and left_ego_image at frame 0. The robot approaches the door and raises it toward the oven during frames 74–103; by frames 104–106, the door is upright against the oven front. Subsequent positioning near the handle is visible in wrist_image, and the door remains closed through frame 343 in image and left_ego_image. No failed attempt, unintended object displacement, or harmful side effect is visibly established.
